title: Only a zealous reading of what it's like makes trouble

statements.text: On a moderate reading, what it is like is how things subjectively seem to a subject. Only a zealous reading, on which it is a monadic property a state has even when the subject is wholly unaware of it, makes empty higher-order states a problem, and that reading is a technical sense with little to support it.

sources.quote: And it is solely what-it's-like-ness zealously construed that causes the alleged troubles for the HO approach.
Consciousness is a matter of mental appearances, and the moderate HO reading of the what-it's-like phrase captures this idea.
